title: No Soil Needed to Grow Air Plants at Home
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: If you are looking for houseplants that do not take up a lot of space and are easy to grow, air plants might be the right choice.
sentences.zh: 如果你在寻找没有占用很多空间 并且易于生长的植物, 空气工厂可能是正确的选择。

sentences.en: There are more than 500 different species of air plants.
sentences.zh: 有500多种不同的空气工厂。

sentences.en: Officially they are known as Tillandsia.
sentences.zh: 官方称他们为提兰迪西亚

sentences.en: These plants are native to places in North and South America that support year-round plant growth.
sentences.zh: 这些植物是北美和南美洲支持植物全年生长的地方的原生植物。

sentences.en: Air plants belong to the same family as the pineapple.
sentences.zh: 空气植物和菠萝属于同一个家庭

sentences.en: Instead of soil, these plants attach themselves to things like trees, rocks and buildings.
sentences.zh: 这些植物没有土壤,而是附着在树木、岩石和建筑上。

sentences.en: They do not cause problems for the objects they grow on.
sentences.zh: 它们不会给它们生长的物体造成问题。

sentences.en: Air plants do not have roots. They depend on specialized cells – called trichomes – to permit their leaves to take in water and nutrients.
sentences.zh: 空气工厂没有根。 它们依靠专门细胞 — — 被称为三合一细胞 — — 来让叶子吸收水和养分。

sentences.en: Associated Press gardening writer Jessica Damiano has experimented with air plants and offers these guidelines for people wanting to grow them.
sentences.zh: 美联社园艺作家Jessica Damiano尝试了空气工厂,

sentences.en: Sunlight Air plants require bright, indirect light.
sentences.zh: 日光航空工厂需要明亮的间接光线。

sentences.en: So, they should be placed near an east- or west-facing window, but not directly in front of it.
sentences.zh: 所以,它们应该放在东面或西面的窗户附近, 而不是直接放在窗户前面。

sentences.en: Direct sunlight can burn the plant’s leaves.
sentences.zh: 直接阳光可以烧掉植物的叶子。

sentences.en: Watering In homes with average humidity levels, put air plants in a bowl of room-temperature water once a week for 30 to 60 minutes.
sentences.zh: 在平均湿度高的家庭里,每周一次将空气工厂放入室内温度水池,耗时30至60分钟。

sentences.en: In homes with drier air, this process can be repeated when needed.
sentences.zh: 在空气较干燥的家庭里,必要时可以重复这一过程。

sentences.en: Lightly shake the plants to remove extra water.
sentences.zh: 轻轻地摇动植物 去除额外的水。

sentences.en: Then, place them upside-down on a cloth to dry for several hours.
sentences.zh: 然后,把它们倒在布上 干几个小时。

sentences.en: This step is necessary to prevent water from collecting on the plant’s leaves, which can cause damage.
sentences.zh: 这一步骤是必要的,以防止在工厂的叶子上取水,这会造成破坏。

sentences.en: If using chlorinated water, it is best to let the liquid sit for 12 to 24 hours to permit the chemical to dissipate before watering plants.
sentences.zh: 如果使用氯化水,最好让液体坐12至24小时,使该化学品在给植物浇水之前能够消散。

sentences.en: Air plants are especially sensitive to chlorine.
sentences.zh: 空气工厂对氯特别敏感。

sentences.en: Feeding the plants Growers should feed their air plants with any all-purpose houseplant, bromeliad or orchid fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 种植者应该用任何用途的家居植物、溴化物或兰花肥料喂养其空气植物。

sentences.en: The substance should be added to the soaking water monthly to provide added nutrients.
sentences.zh: 该物质应添加到每月浸泡的水中,以提供额外营养物质。

sentences.en: Use about half the amount suggested by the fertilizer manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 使用化肥制造商建议的数量的一半左右。

sentences.en: Life cycle Air plants bloom only once. The resulting pink, coral, purple or white flowers are a signal that the plants are nearing death.
sentences.zh: 空气植物只开花过一次 由此产生的粉红色 珊瑚 紫色 白花 是植物接近死亡的信号

sentences.en: However, air plants produce offshoots, known as “pups.” These can be separated into new plants once they grow to about one-third the size of the parent.
sentences.zh: 然而,空气工厂生产副产品,即“小狗 ” 。 一旦它们长到母体大小的三分之一左右,它们就可以分离成新的植物。

sentences.en: So many choices Notable air plants include Spanish moss which can be found hanging from large trees in tropical or subtropical areas.
sentences.zh: 有许多选择 值得注意的空气工厂 包括西班牙苔 可以在热带或亚热带地区的大树上 找到

sentences.en: In the home, Spanish moss is grown in a humid environment, such as a bathroom.
sentences.zh: 在家里,西班牙苔生长在潮湿的环境中,如浴室。

sentences.en: Another kind is Tillandsia ionantha , which is also known as the sky plant.
sentences.zh: 另一类是蒂兰迪亚·伊昂娜塔, 也称为天空植物。

sentences.en: It is a shaggy -looking plant with green bracts.
sentences.zh: 这是一种有绿色胸罩的毛发植物。

sentences.en: Bracts are leaf-like structures that grow from the area just beneath a flower.
sentences.zh: 岩石是叶状结构 生长在一朵花的下面

sentences.en: The tops of bracts can turn pink or purple before flowering.
sentences.zh: 胸罩的顶部在开花前可以变粉色或紫色

sentences.en: Tillandsia caput-medusae is named for its similarity to the snake-haired head of Medusa, from Greek mythology.
sentences.zh: Tillandsia Caput-medusae 被命名为与希腊神话中 蛇毛头的美杜萨相似。

sentences.en: The plant is popular because of its long, wavy leaves that grow upward from a fat, round base.
sentences.zh: 植物很受欢迎 因为它长长的,卷尾叶 从脂肪,圆底。

sentences.en: Perhaps the most unusual species of Tillandsia is the Xerographic air plant.
sentences.zh: 也许提兰迪西亚最不寻常的物种 是Xergraphic航空厂

sentences.en: This kind is known as the King of Air Plants.
sentences.zh: 这种人被称为"航空工厂之王"

sentences.en: It can grow up to about one-half meter. The plant’s long, thin silver leaves curl downward to produce a round shape that sets it apart from other air plants.
sentences.zh: 它可以长到大约半米。 工厂长而薄的银叶向下弯曲,以产生一个与其他空气工厂分开的圆形。

sentences.en: How to show your Tillandsia You can place air plants in just about any spot that provides the required sunlight and good air flow.
sentences.zh: 如何展示你的Tillandsia 你可以把空气工厂放在 任何能提供所需阳光和空气流的地方

sentences.en: Glass containers or terrariums are popular choices.
sentences.zh: 玻璃容器或水族馆是流行的选择。

sentences.en: But growers can also put air plants inside seashells or on rocks.
sentences.zh: 但种植者也可以在贝壳或岩石上安装空气工厂。

sentences.en: One could even create a floating Tillandsia garden by hanging several plants from fishing line.
sentences.zh: 人们甚至可以在钓鱼线上挂上几棵植物,从而建立一个漂浮的蒂兰迪亚花园。

sentences.en: The plants can also be attached to natural wood pieces with wire or glue.
sentences.zh: 这些植物还可以用铁丝或胶水附在天然木块上。

sentences.en: Some choose to grow them inside hanging frames .
sentences.zh: 有些人选择在绞刑框内种植。

sentences.en: When choosing placement possibilities, the main thing to keep in mind is to make sure you are fully meeting all the plant’s needs.
sentences.zh: 在选择安置可能性时,主要要记住的是确保您能充分满足工厂的所有需求。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn. The Associated Press reported this story.
sentences.zh: 我是Bryan Lynn, 美联社报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Bryan Lynn adapted the report for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Bryan Lynn改编了VOA学习英语的报告。
